_about: Bombardier CRJ100/200/440 Airport Planning Manual (CSP A-020, Revision 8), 00-02-01 Figure 2 General Airplane Dimensions (Metric): page index 24, a binarized scan in nine tiles (layers.py --mode image) at scale 10, clip 150,505,480,590 (side). Drawn level (the crown runs level along the cabin): no --rotate. Pixels of that raster, line centres. The crown runs behind the nacelle (its top 0.05 m above the crown). The fin's top fairing (the 'bullet') runs aft to a point over the tailplane's tip; the fin's trailing edge runs up to where the tailplane crosses it, then along the fairing's top from its point forward to the leading edge.
